# ==============================================================================
# Track triggers (blueprint 2.1). global_var:oe_cel_track_override 1-5 (dev page 83) wins over the natural track.
# ==============================================================================

# Country scope. Any non-rebel country leading the Middle Kingdom.
oe_cel_is_celestial_emperor = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	exists = international_organization:middle_kingdom
	is_leader_of_international_organization = international_organization:middle_kingdom
}

# Track 1: Great Yuan (CHI / YUA or a Mongolian culture).
oe_cel_is_yuan_track = {
	oe_cel_is_celestial_emperor = yes
	OR = {
		global_var:oe_cel_track_override ?= 1
		AND = {
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_cel_track_override }
			OR = {
				tag = CHI
				tag = YUA
				culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:mongolian_group }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Track 2: Ming and Han restorations.
oe_cel_is_han_ming_track = {
	oe_cel_is_celestial_emperor = yes
	OR = {
		global_var:oe_cel_track_override ?= 2
		AND = {
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_cel_track_override }
			NOT = { oe_cel_is_yuan_track = yes }
			NOT = { tag = MCH }
			NOT = { culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:jurchen_group } }
			OR = {
				tag = MNG
				tag = WUU
				tag = CSH
				tag = SNG
				tag = HAN
				culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:chinese_group }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Track 3: Qing and Manchu.
oe_cel_is_manchu_qing_track = {
	oe_cel_is_celestial_emperor = yes
	OR = {
		global_var:oe_cel_track_override ?= 3
		AND = {
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_cel_track_override }
			NOT = { oe_cel_is_yuan_track = yes }
			OR = {
				tag = MCH
				tag = JEC
				tag = HNE
				culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:jurchen_group }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Track 4A: Sinosphere heirs (Korea, Japan, Dai Viet, Tibet).
oe_cel_is_sinosphere_alt_track = {
	oe_cel_is_celestial_emperor = yes
	OR = {
		global_var:oe_cel_track_override ?= 4
		AND = {
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_cel_track_override }
			NOT = { oe_cel_is_yuan_track = yes }
			NOT = { oe_cel_is_han_ming_track = yes }
			NOT = { oe_cel_is_manchu_qing_track = yes }
			OR = {
				tag = KOR
				tag = JAP
				tag = ASK
				tag = STC
				tag = NTC
				tag = YMT
				tag = DAI
				tag = TIB
				culture ?= {
					OR = {
						has_culture_group = culture_group:confucian_group
						has_culture_group = culture_group:japanese_group
						has_culture_group = culture_group:tibetan_group
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Track 4B: any other conqueror holding the Mandate.
oe_cel_is_foreign_conqueror_track = {
	oe_cel_is_celestial_emperor = yes
	OR = {
		global_var:oe_cel_track_override ?= 5
		AND = {
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_cel_track_override }
			NOT = { oe_cel_is_yuan_track = yes }
			NOT = { oe_cel_is_han_ming_track = yes }
			NOT = { oe_cel_is_manchu_qing_track = yes }
			NOT = { oe_cel_is_sinosphere_alt_track = yes }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. One of the three celestial subject types.
oe_cel_is_any_celestial_subject = {
	OR = {
		is_subject_type = oe_cel_fanwang
		is_subject_type = oe_cel_xuanweisi
		is_subject_type = oe_cel_grand_duhu
	}
}

# Country scope (the throne). Has a commission or a vanilla tusi that can be brought under direct rule.
oe_cel_has_valid_gaituguiliu_target = {
	any_subject = {
		OR = {
			is_subject_type = oe_cel_xuanweisi
			is_subject_type = tusi
		}
	}
}

# Country scope (a subject). Never touched by v11.2 conversions: the Yuan 1337 provinces.
oe_cel_is_protected_yuan_province = {
	OR = {
		is_subject_type = oe_yp_xingsheng
		is_subject_type = oe_yp_frontier
	}
}

oe_cel_loc_in_zone_anxi = {
